title: Minimax Precision for Any-Treated-Member Effects with Balanced-Subset Outcome Units
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental below floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 5.8 < 7.4; salvageable=false. Both mathematical panelists passed, but the contribution remains confined to the constructed complete half-subset population without operational transfer to observed networks.
gap_reasons: The proofs establish unrestricted risk order 1/m, exact-count order r/m, heterogeneous-product order log(m)/m, and exponential separation from the matching game; product homogeneity is not load-bearing. The distinction from [KHS's exact-configuration theorem](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.04909v1) is justified, while the independently selectable-arm benchmark is already covered by [Sudijono et al.](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.13822v1). The contribution remains confined to the constructed complete half-subset population, and its exponential outcome count supplies a stress test rather than an operational precision criterion for observed networks. The consumer connection establishes relevance of the OR exposure definition, but supplies no transfer of these risk certificates to the consumer's network. The note determines rate-optimal procedures without determining globally optimal design choices or decision rules, and the finite corner program is a reduction rather than a solved design problem. No stale assertion closes the homogeneity question; the projected score is limited by the specialized scope and absence of a deeper optimal-design characterization, rather than by an unmatched rate or an unproved assumption. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived unrestricted OR-network risk order 1/m, exact-count order r/m, product-law order log(m)/m, and exponential separation from the independent-arm matching game. Both substantive mathematical panel reviews passed; the calibrated novelty verdict was incremental below the field floor because the result remains a specialized constructed-population stress test without transfer to observed networks. Terminal audit found that exact-constant optimization would require a new minimax program and would not cure the scope objections; no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: An experiment with all balanced subsets as outcome units has exponentially many responses but only inverse-intervention-count precision for the effect of having any treated member. The target result optimizes every assignment law and every measurable estimator over arbitrary fixed bounded endpoints. Uniform singleton treatment attains \(R_m=\Theta(1/m)\), while the same endpoint box in the pairwise matching observation game has risk \(\Theta(1/N)\). Exact treatment counts and independent intervention assignment yield further precision comparisons without changing the outcome model. Whether heterogeneous independent assignment improves the finite optimum remains an explicit question.
gap: The exact-configuration realization in Kandiros, Harshaw, and Sävje (2026, Appendix A.5) does not characterize feasible unions of configurations. No opened source supplies the complete balanced-subset OR all-design, all-estimator precision comparison.
fill: A constructive \(1/m\) upper certificate and unrestricted converse determine actual information order. The separately credited matching benchmark quantifies the exponential discrepancy; count and product restrictions explain which design decisions affect it.
